title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield
abstract: arXiv:2609.17464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems split a task across a tree of agents and justify the split with folklore: smaller contexts, cleaner separation, parallelism. We ask what the split does to how much of what the leaves discover reaches the root. Model a decomposition as a tree in which an agent handed $b$ items keeps any one with probability $r(b)$. If $r(b)=1/b$, every tree delivers exactly one finding, for every task size and every shape; we verify this to $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$ on 20,000 random irregular trees. If $r(b)=Cb^{-\delta}$, a depth-$k$ tree over $N$ findings yields $C^k N^{1-\delta}$: task size and architecture separate, and architecture contributes only $C \le 1$ per level, so flat is optimal for yield and no arrangement of agents escapes the exponent $\delta$. On 600 production deep-research traces $\delta = 0.34$ [0.30, 0.38], by three identifications that do not share a failure mode. At a hop where item boundaries come from the tool r

translated_title: 分解买到的是完整性，而非产量
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统将任务分解到一个智能体树结构中，并用流传的经验说法为这种分解辩护：更小的上下文、更清晰的职责分离、并行性。我们探究这种分解对于叶子节点所发现的信息有多少能够传递到根节点产生了什么影响。我们将分解建模为一棵树，其中被交给 $b$ 个条目的智能体以概率 $r(b)$ 保留其中任意一个。如果 $r(b)=1/b$，那么对于任何任务规模和任何树形结构，每棵树都恰好传递一个发现；我们在20,000棵随机不规则树上对此进行了验证，误差精度达到 $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$。如果 $r(b)=Cb^{-\delta}$，那么一棵作用于 $N$ 个发现、深度为 $k$ 的树将产生 $C^k N^{1-\delta}$：任务规模与架构相互分离，而架构在每一层仅贡献 $C \le 1$ 的因子，因此扁平结构对于产量是最优的，且任何智能体排列方式都无法摆脱指数 $\delta$ 的约束。在600条生产环境的深度研究轨迹上，通过三种不共享失效模式的识别方法，测得 $\delta = 0.34$ [0.30, 0.38]。在条目边界由工具确定的跳数处……
tldr: 该论文通过数学建模与实证测量证明，多智能体任务分解无法提升信息传递的产量——无论树形架构如何设计，信息损失指数都不变，扁平结构才是产量最优的选择，分解只能保证完整性而无法提高产出。
en_tdlr: This paper proves mathematically and empirically that multi-agent task decomposition cannot improve information yield—regardless of the tree architecture, the information loss exponent remains unchanged, flat structures are yield-optimal, and decomposition buys integrity rather than yield.
